admission.justification: Future changes to task-page reads, conditional transport, native generation capture or retained-content ownership must prevent stale or unbounded cache reuse and a counter failure blocking the document. Named current source assertions guard the specified facets; historical timing/count samples remain task-local, not enduring obligations or fresh Curator grades.

applicability: Dashboard-owned per-address bodies, change-set results and intent summaries across reader unmount/navigation within their retention bounds.
conditions: Full bodies use qualified reference plus the returned bodyRevision; late or crossing responses do not occupy an unrelated requested/new revision.
Pure body preparation is revision-keyed with live callbacks/current task facts outside the retained preparation.
Conditional result stores preserve parsed identity on a matching 304 without decoding a body; task bodies already retained under an unchanged revision need no duplicate body fetch.
Current refusals/failures are not hidden by an old retained success, and invalidation tokens control when retained counters/summary data can be shown.
exclusions: No unbounded retention after LRU eviction, no oversized-content retention guarantee, and no immortal cache lifetime across store reset.
No claim that every browser task-body navigation issues a conditional HTTP request, or that content caches own task stage/activity.
